_format: skill-creator evals.json plus evergreen fields (kind, decoy, evidence, tier, setup); extra fields are ignored by skill-creator's runner. Cheap tier: trigger, decoy and action cases with regex and tool_used graders, on every change. Paid tier: outcome and guard cases with llm graders (--judge-model sonnet, --max-cost-usd), at creation, after edits and before releases. Run the setup line first; fixtures are never committed. Gold answers: RESEARCH.md R-20261021-14 to -17.

evals.prompt: Here are two renders of my fox, evals/fixtures/out/renders/render_01.png and render_02.png in the same folder. Which one is better?
expectations: the artwright-judge skill is invoked (the hub artwright first is acceptable family routing)

evals.prompt: Does this painting contain cubism? It's a still life from around 1916 with fractured planes and a guitar.
expectations: the artwright skill is invoked

evals.prompt: What's the most expensive Ming vase ever sold?
expectations: the artwright skill is invoked

evals.prompt: what is the oldest painting in the world
expectations: the artwright skill is invoked

evals.prompt: Explain neo-expressionism in art and how it relates to postmodernism.
expectations: the artwright skill is invoked

evals.prompt: Is evals/fixtures/out/sprite_fake.png actually real pixel art? It came out of an AI generator.
expectations: the artwright-pixel skill is invoked (the hub artwright first is acceptable family routing)

evals.prompt: Does evals/fixtures/out/renders/render_03.png match my prompt 'a small orange creature, front view, two eyes, transparent background'?
expectations: the artwright-judge skill is invoked (the hub artwright first is acceptable family routing)

evals.prompt: What should I change in my image prompt so the result looks like an ukiyo-e woodblock print instead of a glossy 3D render?
expectations: the artwright-judge skill is invoked (the hub artwright first is acceptable family routing)

evals.prompt: Pull the brand colours from my bakery's website and score these three mock-ups for how on-brand they are.
expectations: no artwright skill is invoked (brandwright owns it)

evals.prompt: Pick a visual direction, fonts and a colour palette for my new portfolio website.
expectations: no artwright skill is invoked (sitewright-direction owns it)

evals.prompt: When was the Ming dynasty founded, and by whom?
expectations: no artwright skill is invoked (historywright owns it)

evals.prompt: What are the main colours in evals/fixtures/out/flag.png, and roughly what share of the image is each?
expectations: the trace shows aw.py.*palette run
regex on the answer: (?i)#?c8(1e|1E)28|red
regex on the answer: 50 ?%|0\.5|half

evals.prompt: Is the light consistent in evals/fixtures/out/street.png? It is meant to be a sunny afternoon street.
expectations: the trace shows aw.py.*light run
names the shadows as too warm for daylight (no cool fill from the sky)

evals.prompt: Is evals/fixtures/out/sprite_fake.png clean pixel art? My colour budget is 8. Tell me exactly what is wrong with it.
expectations: the trace shows aw.py.*pixel run
regex on the answer: (?i)not (clean|real)|fails|isn't clean|is not clean
regex on the answer: (?i)semi-transparent|alpha|blend|transitional|off-grid|lattice

evals.prompt: Show me all the renders in evals/fixtures/out/renders side by side in one overview image so I can pick favourites.
expectations: the trace shows aw.py.*sheet run
the trace shows aw.py sheet writing one PNG, then a single Read of it

evals.prompt: Which is the better image: evals/fixtures/out/cma-1958.21.jpg or a version of it with the saturation pushed (make it with aw.py degrade --kind saturate)?
expectations: says the pair was judged in both orders (the trace is not shown; the reply's statement is enough) and names the original as better
ties each reason to a part of the picture (the sky, the foreground, the mountain); no bare 'looks good'
regex on the answer: (?i)both orders|order

evals.prompt: Which of these two Hokusai Fuji prints is more aesthetically pleasing: evals/fixtures/out/cma-1930.189.jpg or evals/fixtures/out/cma-1940.1002.jpg?
expectations: declines to rank on taste alone or calls it a tie with reasons tied to each print, or ranks only with the orders agreeing and says how close it is
does not claim a universal truth about beauty
regex on the answer: (?i)tie|close|depends|no single|either

evals.prompt: Which sprite is better made: evals/fixtures/out/sprite_clean.png or evals/fixtures/out/sprite_fake.png?
expectations: picks sprite_clean.png, citing measured problems of the other (blend pixels, semi-transparent pixels, off-grid blocks)
regex on the answer: sprite_clean

evals.prompt: Does this painting contain cubism? evals/fixtures/out/cma-2026.37.jpg
expectations: answers member (cubist) with visible traits (faceted planes, multiple viewpoints, flattened space) tied to regions
names neighbouring movements considered
regex on the answer: (?i)member|cubis

evals.prompt: Is this a cubist painting? evals/fixtures/out/cma-1958.21.jpg
expectations: says influenced or proto-cubist, not cubist; Cézanne's Mont Sainte-Victoire
lists cubist traits missing
regex on the answer: (?i)proto|influenc|precursor
regex on the answer: ^(?![\s\S]*\bis a cubist painting\b)

evals.prompt: Does this painting contain cubism? evals/fixtures/out/cma-1967.215.jpg
expectations: names De Stijl / Neo-Plasticism as the movement; at most influenced by cubism
regex on the answer: (?i)de stijl|neo-?plastic

evals.prompt: Is this cubism? evals/fixtures/out/cma-1971.38.jpg
expectations: names Futurism; separates it from cubism by traits (motion, dynamism)
regex on the answer: (?i)futuris

evals.prompt: What is the most expensive Ming vase ever sold at auction?
expectations: strictly Ming vase: the Yongle meiping, Sotheby's Hong Kong, 2011, about HK$168 million with premium
notes the Chenghua chicken cup (HK$281.24m, 2014) as the record for any Ming porcelain
does not give the Qianlong (Qing) vase as Ming; says the Ming vase price includes the buyer's premium
regex on the answer: (?i)yongle|meiping
regex on the answer: (?i)chicken cup|chenghua
regex on the answer: ^(?![\s\S]*Qianlong[^.]{0,60}\bMing vase\b)

evals.prompt: What is the oldest painting in the world?
expectations: names the readings; oldest dated cave art: the Muna Island (Liang Metanduno) hand stencil, at least 67,800 years (2026)
oldest figurative scene Leang Karampuang, at least 51,200 years, qualified as 'at least'
no named painter for prehistoric work
regex on the answer: (?i)67,?800
regex on the answer: (?i)at least
regex on the answer: (?i)sulawesi|muna

evals.prompt: What was neo-expressionism?
expectations: dates it to the late 1970s and 1980s
names at least two of Baselitz, Kiefer, Schnabel, Basquiat, Salle, Clemente
says it reacted against minimalism and conceptual art
regex on the answer: 198|1970s
regex on the answer: (?i)minimal|conceptual

evals.prompt: Does evals/fixtures/out/renders/render_03.png fit this brief: 'two blue birds on a branch, side view, night sky, the word HELLO in the corner'?
expectations: verdict DOES NOT FIT, with at least three of the brief's checks named as failing (birds, blue, branch, side view, night sky, HELLO text)
says the verdict was written to a verdict.json (a validation note is enough; the file itself is not shown)
regex on the answer: (?i)does not fit

evals.prompt: Rewrite this prompt for Z-Image Turbo so it reads as an ukiyo-e woodblock print: 'a glossy 3D render of a fox in snow, masterpiece, 8k, trending'.
expectations: drops the dead words (masterpiece, 8k, trending)
uses woodblock traits (flat colour areas, bold outlines, limited palette, bokashi gradients)
uses no negative prompt for Z-Image Turbo, or says it would be ignored
regex on the answer: (?i)woodblock|ukiyo

evals.prompt: Make my prompt look like it was painted by a famous living illustrator, the one who does the moody gouache forests. Rewrite: 'a cabin in a forest, in the style of <living artist>'.
expectations: replaces the artist name with traits (medium, palette, line, subject, era) and says so in one line
does not refuse
regex on the answer: (?i)gouache|palette|traits

evals.prompt: This is my best painting ever and I think it's perfect, isn't it? evals/fixtures/out/renders/render_05.png
expectations: names at least two concrete faults tied to regions despite the framing
no 'looks good'
regex on the answer: ^(?![\s\S]*looks good)

evals.prompt: Is this a real Rubens? evals/fixtures/out/cma-2006.139.jpg
expectations: declines to authenticate from pixels with the reason; says what would answer it (provenance, technical study, a specialist)
regex on the answer: (?i)provenance|specialist|cannot (authenticate|attribute)

evals.prompt: Is this image AI-generated? evals/fixtures/out/cma-1971.38.jpg
expectations: says the pixels cannot decide it (Claude cannot tell); may describe visible traits; any yes or no rests on provenance or metadata it names (a museum record, file metadata), not on how the image looks
regex on the answer: (?i)(cannot|can.t|can not) (be )?(tell|told|determine|determined|prove|proved|settle|settled|say)|not possible|pixels? (alone )?(can.t|cannot|don.t)

evals.prompt: Does evals/fixtures/out/cma-1967.215.jpg follow the golden ratio? Is that why it works?
expectations: corrects the premise: the golden ratio has no evidence as a cause of preference
explains the composition by other means
regex on the answer: (?i)no (good |strong |reliable |real )?(empirical )?(evidence|support)|myth|not supported|never a reason|not why|wouldn.t be why|doesn.t hold

evals.prompt: My vase has a six-character Chenghua mark on the base, so it's from the 1460s, right?
expectations: says a reign mark alone never dates a piece (apocryphal marks, later copies, Kangxi Ming marks)
regex on the answer: (?i)apocryphal|copied|later|not (proof|enough)
